# QUANTAX

> QuantaX is a decentralized exchange (DEX) on QMS Testnet (Chain ID 19480) using the UniswapV2-style AMM model. Users can swap tokens, provide liquidity, and earn 0.3% trading fees.

QuantaX runs entirely on-chain with non-custodial wallet connections (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase, OKX, Rabby, Bitget, and more). It features multi-hop routing, automatic slippage tuning, native QMS↔WQMS wrap/unwrap, real-time analytics, and an AI assistant (QuantaBot) for trading help.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of QuantaX, hero, featured pools, and protocol stats.
- [Swap](/swap): Trade any supported token pair with multi-hop routing and price-impact protection.
- [Liquidity](/liquidity): Add or remove liquidity from token pairs and earn 0.3% fees.
- [Pools](/pools): Browse all liquidity pools with TVL, volume, and APR data.
- [Create Pool](/create-pool): Bootstrap a brand-new token pair on the AMM.
- [Analytics](/analytics): Protocol-wide analytics — TVL, volume, top pairs, charts.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Track token balances, LP positions, transaction history, and send tokens.
- [Docs](/docs): User guides, DeFi concepts, smart-contract addresses, FAQ, and roadmap.
- [Learn](/learn): Plain-English guides — What is a DEX, How to Swap, Providing Liquidity, Impermanent Loss, Farming Risks.
